name: Thetanuts
summary: Thetanuts IndexVault.mint() computes each required component-vault transfer with truncating integer division and accepts zero amounts. After claiming flash-borrowed index shares reduced totalSupply to three, the attacker made 37 sub-supply mints whose component transfers all rounded to zero, reminted the shares needed to repay Aave, and kept the five component-vault balances.
notes: The top-level CREATE installed the direct 12,494-byte IndexVault runtime containing claim() and mint(); its runtime hash is unchanged immediately before the exploit.

The exploit receipt measures exact net proceeds of 105,471.499078 USDC plus 33,593.775337 residual AVAXUSD, BNBUSD, and MATICUSD component-vault shares. Gross IndexVault depletion was also exact: 49,716.431047 BTCUSD, 23,955.277333 ETHUSD, and those three residual balances. The attacker disposed of the BTCUSD and ETHUSD shares through initWithdraw to obtain the USDC; the USD total uses those realised proceeds and conservatively excludes the unvalued residual shares. The approximately $2.1 million cited for the incident was value at risk, not realised loss, because a whitehat rescued approximately $2 million.
The comparable USD total conservatively excludes 33,593.775337 residual component-vault shares whose incident-time value was not independently established.
